sources.content: The arnovel-db image runs ArnovelDB, a small relational database for edge devices. It is based on debian:12-slim and runs as user arnovel with user ID 999. Clients connect on port 6420, and the HTTP admin console listens on port 6480. Data files live in /var/lib/arnovel; mount a volume there or data is lost when the container is removed. The entrypoint script is /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh, and it starts the server with arnoveld and the config file /etc/arnovel/arnovel.conf.

On first start, the entrypoint creates a database named after ARNOVEL_DB, which defaults to app. ARNOVEL_PASSWORD sets the password for the admin user and is required; the container refuses to start without it. ARNOVEL_MAX_MEMORY caps the memory used for caching and defaults to 256MB. Scripts placed in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d run once, in alphabetical order, when the data directory is empty. The health check runs arnovel-cli ping every 10 seconds. Logs go to standard output.
